judgments.title: Ketua Pengarah Hasil Dalam Negeri v LUSH DEVELOPMENT SDN BHD
judgments.catchwords: Section 4C, Income Tax Act 1967: deemed business income on compulsory acquisition of stock-in-trade - Article 13(2), Federal Constitution: right to adequate compensation for property - Wiramuda (M) Sdn Bhd v KPHDN [2023] 4 MLJ 753: Federal Court held s 4C unconstitutional - Retrospective vs prospective effect of judgments: whether Wiramuda applies retrospectively - Prospective overruling: including the Revenue’s “selective” or “fourth category” variant - Judicial review (Order 53, Rules of Court 2012) - Tax refund: tax paid under an unconstitutional provision Decision, action or omission (O 53 r 2(4)): whether the Revenue’s non-response to the letter of 21.2.2023 was reviewable - Time limit for judicial review (O 53 r 3(6)) - Continuing public duty of the Executive: duty to give effect to a binding Federal Court ruling (stare decisis) - Certiorari vs mandamus: certiorari cannot quash an omission, so the order was affirmed as mandamus - Sections 97, 99 and 111, ITA: finality of assessment, appeal and relief for error or mistake (rejected as a bar) - Interest on refund: 5% p.a. from 8.3.2023 - Compulsory acquisition compensation - Self-assessment / deemed assessment (s 90 ITA) - “Floodgates” argument: rejected as unsupported by evidence

judgments.title: ANGELINE A/P ANTHONYSAMY @ SOOSAI v S.PATRICK SHANKER SIVAGNANAM
judgments.catchwords: The Defendant’s preliminary objection is dismissed. 2. The Defendant shall, within 14 days, from the date of the Order, furnish the UBS Switzerland account statements for Account Nos. 233 and 789 from 17.7.2014 until closure, together with the redacted RHB Bank statements confirming the remittance of RM1,339,391.80. 3. The Defendant shall, within 14 days from the date of the order execute and deliver written authorisation to Shell Business Service Centre Sdn Bhd enabling disclosure of all information relating to the 4,794 Royal Dutch Shell A shares, including reconciliation and payments made following Paul’s demise. 4. The Court finds that SOCSO dependants’ benefits, once lawfully received by Anne, fall within the sharing framework of the 2015 Agreement. Accordingly, the Defendant shall, within fourteen (14) days from the date of this Order, render a full account of all SOCSO benefits or payments payable arising from the demise of Paul Rajasingam a/l Sivagnanam. Upon providing such account, the Defendant shall thereafter pay to the Plaintiff one half of the said benefits or payments in accordance with the Agreement. 5. Both parties shall file verified schedules of disbursements and administration expenses, together with supporting documentation, chargeable under Clause 13 of the Agreement; 6. Administration Expenses: Upon consideration of the parties’ respective schedules of disbursements and the terms of Clause 13 of the Agreement dated 25.1.2015, and pursuant to the Court’s jurisdiction under Order 80 rule 2(3)(c) and (e) and Order 43 of the Rules of Court 2012, this Court directs that all administration expenses properly incurred in the course of administering the estates of Paul Rajasingam and Mabel Anthonysamy shall be verified, classified, and apportioned as follows: (a) expenses reasonably and necessarily incurred for the joint administration of both estates shall be borne equally; (b) expenses referable solely to Paul’s estate shall be chargeable to Paul’s estate; (c) expenses referable solely to Mabel’s estate shall be chargeable to Mabel’s estate. The parties shall file verified schedules of disbursements, with supporting documentation, for determination prior to final reconciliation and distribution.
judgments.judge: YA Tuan Nixon Anak Kennedy Kumbong

judgments.title: Pendakwa Raya & ors v Julasiri Bin Akilmara
judgments.catchwords: Offence under section 39B(1)(a) of the Dangerous Drugs Act 1952 read together with section 34 of the Penal Code - Whether the trial judge should have informed at the close of the prosecution's case, that the defence was being called upon to answer a case of actual trafficking or presumed trafficking? - Overwhelming evidence proved the elements of custody, control, and knowledge - Actual possession of the impugned drugs was established - Section 180 (1) and (4) of the Criminal Procedure Code - Procedure after conclusion of case for prosecution - No statutory or legal requirement to state the presumption when calling for the defence - Formal verbal label for an evidentiary rule at the close of the prosecution's case is unnecessary - Statutory presumption of trafficking under section 37(da)(xvi) of the Dangerous Drugs Act 1952 - Section 422 of the Criminal Procedure Code - Not vitiate the conviction - No miscarriage of justice - Failure either to make or to record such a finding does not ipso facto - The law does not require a mini-judgment or detailed legal reasons at the close of the prosecution’s case

judgments.title: BELLWORTH DEVELOPMENTS SDN BHD v SETIAKON BUILDERS SDN BHD
judgments.catchwords: The Court of Appeal reaffirmed the principle of minimal judicial intervention in arbitration. A procedural breach, such as an alleged one-day delay in submitting a draft award for AIAC technical review, does not automatically invalidate an arbitral award where the requirement is merely directory, no timely objection was raised, and no prejudice is shown. An arbitral award will not be set aside on the basis of a purported “new difference” where the issue was within the parties’ pleadings, evidence and submissions. Courts will not review the merits of an award under the guise of a setting-aside application.’

judgments.title: Kerajaan Malaysia v KONSORTIUM KMS INGENIEUR - BENTARA -RMR
judgments.catchwords: Kontrak : Kemungkiran - perjanjian perundingan bagi merekabentuk jambatan - keretakan pada jambatan - sama ada keretakan jambatan berpunca dari kecacatan rekabentuk - sama ada keretakan berpunca dari kerja-kerja pembinaan. - Perjanjian 'Standard' - cara meminda perjanjian 'Standard'. - Lantikan perunding untuk jalankan sebahagian kerja sahaja - sama ada keseluruhan kandungan perjanjian terpakai kepada perunding - sama ada perunding bebas untuk memilih peruntukan mana yang terpakai. - Sama ada yuran perunding boleh ditahan oleh pemilik projek tanpa peruntukan nyata dalam perjanjian.
